sources.method: Entry-level search locator used for orientation only; specific statements are checked against the higher-tier reference and official records where available.

statement.zh: **领域**：后量子（Post-Quantum）。NIST IR 8547 以其用途来界定这一领域。报告在 nist-ir8547-final.txt:202-203 先承认悬而未决的问题：「future quantum computing may be able to break these algorithms, rendering data and information vulnerable」（未来的量子计算可能攻破这些算法，使数据与信息安全暴露于风险）；随后在 203-205 行给出应对的定义：「Countering this future quantum capability requires new cryptographic methods that can protect data from both current conventional computers and the quantum computers of tomorrow.」（要对抗这种未来的量子能力，就需要既能抵御当今经典计算机、也能抵御未来量子计算机的新技术），并且 「These methods are referred to as post-quantum cryptography (PQC).」（这些方法被称为后量子密码（PQC））。这个定义里有两处承重。其一，要求是双重的：PQC 必须扛住今天的经典攻击，而不只是假想的量子攻击。其二，通篇的限定语在认识上是留有余地的：文中所说的能力是一种未来的可能性，报告自己在 216-217 行也指出这场迁移开始于具有破解能力的量子计算机建成之前。
statement.en: **Domain**: Post-Quantum.It is registered under post-quantum cryptography.

statement.zh: 既然还没有有破解能力的量子计算机，为什么现在就动手？报告用一套时间论证作答。风险长寿：「Since sensitive data often retains its value for many years, starting the transition to post-quantum cryptography now is critical to preventing these future breaches.」（敏感数据往往多年后仍有价值，现在就开始向后量子密码迁移，对防止未来的泄露至关重要）（nist-ir8547-final.txt:219-221）。源文件自带引号点名的对手行为（第 218 行）：加密数据会在 「harvest now, decrypt later」（现在收获、日后解密） 策略下被先行收集，而 「This threat model is one of the main reasons why the transition to post-quantum cryptography is urgent.」（这一威胁模型正是迁移刻不容缓的主因之一）。迁移耗时：「Historically, the journey from algorithm standardization to full integration into information systems can take 10 to 20 years.」（历史上，从算法标准化到完全集成进信息系统可能需要 10 到 20 年）（210-211 行）。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in post-quantum cryptography, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 用途由标准自己记录。FIPS 203（按其第 13 行于 2024 年 8 月 13 日发布）在 fips203.txt:28 给出了第一个标准化主力算法的功能位置：「A shared secret key that is securely established using a KEM can then be used with symmetric-key cryptographic algorithms to perform basic tasks in secure communications, such as encryption and authentication.」（用 KEM 安全建立的共享密钥可再与对称密钥算法配合，完成加密与认证等安全通信基本任务），以及 「This standard specifies a key-encapsulation mechanism called ML-KEM.」（本标准规定了一个称为 ML-KEM 的密钥封装机制）。它声明的依据是格问题的困难性而非被证明的安全性：「The security of ML-KEM is related to the computational difficulty of the Module Learning with Errors problem.At present, ML-KEM is believed to be secure, even against adversaries who possess a quantum computer.

statement.zh: 这一领域是相对着一场被预期而非被展示的攻破来定义自身的，其文献自己也保持这种不对称可见。处于风险中的是什么，三份 FIPS 的前言几乎逐字相同；FIPS 205 印在 fips205.txt:279：「The security of many commonly used public-key cryptosystems will be at risk if large-scale quantum computers are ever realized.」（一旦大规模量子计算机成为现实，许多常用公钥密码体制的安全将处于风险之中）——即原理一节所引那行的上一句，回指的是同段点名的基于整数分解与离散对数的体制。替代方案给出的同样是设计意图与假设，而非定理：SLH-DSA 「relies on the presumed difficulty of finding preimages for hash functions as well as several related properties of the same hash functions」（依赖的是寻找哈希原像的假定困难性以及同一哈希函数的若干相关性质）（fips205.txt:276），同句继续说 「Unlike the algorithms specified in FIPS 186-5 [1], SLH-DSA is designed to provide resistance against attacks from a large-scale quantum computer.
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: 留存文本印出的可定年历史是标准化时间线，FIPS 204 把它写得相当紧凑。过程起点，fips204.txt:247：「in 2016, NIST initiated a public Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Standardization process」（2016 年，NIST 启动公开的向后量子密码标准化过程），同一行还有 「A total of 82 candidate algorithms were submitted to NIST for consideration.」（共有 82 个候选算法提交给 NIST 评审）。遴选结果，fips204.txt:248：「After three rounds of evaluation and analysis, NIST selected the first four algorithms for standardization.」（经过三轮评估与分析，NIST 选出了首批四项待标准化算法），以及 「ML-DSA is derived from one of the selected schemes, CRYSTALS-DILITHIUM」（ML-DSA derived 自入选方案之一的 CRYSTALS-DILITHIUM）——被标准化的对象点名了它的前身提交方案。
